project.description: The config domain's seam: BootstrapConfig, the Pulumi-free record of derived Stage-A bootstrap settings (paths, incus/image/network coordinates, endpoints, timeouts) plus the pure NFS-automount path rewriting (pathOn/worktreeDirOn). The derivation FROM the Pulumi-backed Rke2labConfig lives host-side; this record is the flat frontier value both worlds carry. type=seam: system-exported, one shared copy across the host↔bundle boundary, like every -port.
